[Problem]{.card-kicker} **3Sum** [LC 15 · 3Sum](https://leetcode.com/problems/3sum/){difficulty="Medium"}

A triple is "one number plus a *pair that sums to its negation*". Sort once; then **fix** the smallest element $a[i]$ and the remaining question — "find pairs in $a[i+1 \dots n-1]$ summing to $-a[i]$" — is exactly the @sec-tp-p1-a squeeze on the sorted tail. Skipping equal values of $a[i]$, and skipping equal values at $\mathit{lo}/\mathit{hi}$ after a hit, is what removes duplicate triples. Sorting also lets you cut early: if $a[i] > 0$ no later triple can sum to $0$.

[Solved in full in @sec-tp-p2-a.]{.card-link}

:::
